_README: A programme: any long-running practice with goals, phases and reps. Load it with scripts/load-program.py <file>, which is idempotent by name -- run it again after editing and only the new entries are added. Keep your own programmes outside the repo (~/Library/Application Support/second-brain/programs/); this file is the shape, not a plan.

areas.name: Learn to sail
areas.description: The standing commitment this programme hangs off. An area has no end date.
areas.standard: Optional: the bar you are holding yourself to, read back to you on the area page.
areas.nextSteps: Optional: the one concrete thing to do next.
tasks: A bare string is a task with no date or notes

notes.title: Knots worth knowing
notes.body: Notes become note items filed in this container. Markdown works.

projects.name: Term 1 - Dinghy basics
projects.goal: One sentence on what finishing looks like.
projects.description: A phase of the programme. Give it a deadline and its progress bar becomes the phase's own gate.

tasks.title: Gate: can sail a triangle course single-handed
tasks.notes: Gate items are ordinary tasks due on the phase's last day, so the project's progress bar is the gate.

resources.name: Sailing reading list
resources.description: Categories: articles, tools, reference, research, inspiration, videos, other.

goals.outcome: The scoreable target, in one line.
